title: Astrologer workspace
reviewIntro: Review interpretations against computed chart facts and their sources.
profileIntro: Submit your professional credentials or check your review access.
queueStubBody: The current endpoint verifies access and returns a placeholder response. Review assignments will appear here when the service is ready.
factsBody: Check computed placements, houses, and chart conventions.
sourcesBody: Inspect the references cited in each interpretation.
interpretationBody: Compare the interpretation with its evidence before approving, editing, or rejecting it.
privacy: Reviewers will see derived chart facts. Personal identity, birth details, and coordinates stay private.
disclaimer: Astronomy determines the chart positions. Traditional interpretations are for reflection and cultural exploration. Research has yet to establish that they predict events.
signedOutBody: Sign in to apply as an astrologer or check your review access.
sessionUnavailable: The sign-in service could not be reached. Try again.
accessDeniedBody: Only approved astrologers and administrators can access reviews. You can submit an application from your professional profile.
standingUnknown: We could not confirm your approval or account standing. If your review access was suspended, contact an administrator.
accessError: Review access could not be checked. Try again.
expired: Your session could not be verified. Sign in again to continue.
applicationBody: Tell us about your practice. An administrator reviews your application before granting review access.
applicationStatusUnavailable: Kundali cannot look up your application or profile status after you leave this page. You can check review access at any time.
pendingBody: Your application was received. An administrator needs to approve it before review access is granted.
duplicate: An application already exists for this account. Its current status is unavailable here.
professionalUnavailable: Saved credentials are unavailable here. Kundali does not currently provide a self-service professional profile lookup.
credentialHint: Describe your training or experience. Keep private documents and identification numbers out of this field.
nameError: Enter a name between 2 and 100 characters.
credentialsError: Describe your credentials in at least 10 characters.
traditionError: Enter a tradition between 2 and 100 characters.
validation: The application did not pass validation. Review your entries and try again.
applicationForbidden: This account could not submit an application.
applicationError: We could not confirm submission. Try again to check whether it was received.
